headline: President Prabowo Subianto Convenes Ten Former Police Chiefs Meeting
seoTitle: Prabowo Hosts Former Police Chiefs in Hambalang
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto met with ten former National Police Chiefs in Hambalang to discuss current national issues and government policy support.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former National Police Chiefs at his residence in Hambalang.
The session included the current Minister of Home Affairs, Tito Karnavian, alongside other retired police leadership.
Discussions focused on exchanging perspectives regarding current national developments and backing government initiatives.
aiContextParagraph: On November 8, 2026, President Prabowo Subianto hosted a gathering at his residence in Hambalang, Bogor, attended by ten former Chiefs of the Indonesian National Police (Kapolri). The event featured a cross-generational assembly of retired police leaders, including the current Minister of Home Affairs, Tito Karnavian. While the meeting was described by participants as a cordial gathering to maintain unity among leadership generations, reports also indicated that the discussion touched upon internal police affairs, current national issues, and the expression of support for the administration's policies. Media coverage noted that former National Police Chief Idham Azis was not among those present at the event. This meeting follows a series of interactions between the administration and prominent figures within the national security apparatus, signaling a focus on institutional alignment and dialogue with senior law enforcement officials to address various government priorities.
whyItIsViral: The story is highly viral due to rapid coverage across six major independent news outlets in Indonesia, achieving a high velocity score of 82/100.
